meta: MediNova for clinics — pricing and features
title: Run your clinic on MediNova
subtitle: Online booking, staff accounts, invoicing and a full patient record — in one place, under your own name and logo.
ctaTitle: Ready to move your clinic online?
ctaBody: Every plan starts with a 14-day trial. We help you import your doctors, schedules and fees.

trust.title: Your brand, not ours
trust.body: Your name, logo and colours across the booking site, prescriptions and invoices.

trust.title: Works in Bengali
trust.body: Full English and Bengali support for patients and staff, including printed documents.

trust.title: Money handled properly
trust.body: Invoices, discounts, partial payments and statements — all in taka, no rounding surprises.

trust.title: Records you can defend
trust.body: Every consultation, vital sign and diagnosis is captured with who recorded it and when.

trust.title: Separate clinics stay separate
trust.body: Row-level security means one clinic can never read another clinic's patients.

trust.title: No lock-in
trust.body: Export every record at any time. Your patients' data is yours, not our leverage.

faqs.q: Can I use my own name and logo?
faqs.a: Yes. Your name, logo and colours appear on the booking site and every patient document.

faqs.q: Do you charge per patient or per appointment?
faqs.a: No. The monthly fee covers your whole clinic. Patients never see a subscription charge.

faqs.q: Can you migrate our existing doctors and fees?
faqs.a: Yes. We import your doctor list, schedules and fee structure during onboarding.

faqs.q: What happens to our data if we cancel?
faqs.a: You keep read and export access, and can download every record whenever you need it.
Every table is protected by row-level security, so staff only ever see their own clinic's patients.
